start: Member app joined to Crispy Curves; the desk has already confirmed this phone's mobile number; member is at the gym with a live plan

steps.action: Scan the QR poster at the desk with the phone camera
user_sees: Screen 'Check in at Crispy Curves'
'Tap Check in when you are at the gym.'
must_not: Another gym's name on the screen
A number asked for again after the desk confirmed it

steps.action: Tap Check in
user_sees: 'You're checked in at 6:42 pm' with the member's first name
must_not: Two visit rows for the same member on the same day
The visit dated on another day than today in India

steps.action: At the desk, open the attendance register in the admin app
user_sees: The visit listed with a small 'App' tag after the next pull
must_not: The visit missing from the register
The visit shown twice

start: Member app, Gym tab, desk has confirmed the number

steps.action: Tap 'Check in' on the Gym tab
user_sees: A scanner opens inside MettleUp
must_not: The phone camera app opened instead with no way back to MettleUp

steps.action: Point it at the QR poster at the desk
user_sees: 'You're checked in' with the time
must_not: A second visit made because the poster was scanned twice

start: Member of a gym with branches; the plan is marked for every branch; member is at another branch of the same business

steps.action: Scan the other branch's QR poster and tap Check in
user_sees: 'You're checked in' with the branch's name
must_not: 'You're not a member of this gym in the app.' for a plan that covers every branch
The visit written to a gym of another business

steps.action: Repeat with a plan that is NOT marked for every branch
user_sees: A refusal naming the branch; no visit written
must_not: A visit written at the branch

start: First check-in: the app has no mobile number for this member yet

steps.action: Scan the poster and tap Check in
user_sees: 'Type the mobile number your gym has for you. The app asks only once.'
must_not: A check-in made with no number

steps.action: Type 9 digits and send
user_sees: 'That isn't a 10-digit mobile number. Check it and try again.'
must_not: The short number saved

steps.action: Type a number that is on the gym's list
user_sees: 'First check-in: go to the front desk and ask them to confirm your mobile number. When they say it is done, tap Check in below. You do this only once.'
must_not: The member's first name or plan shown before the desk confirms
'You're checked in' before the desk confirms

steps.action: Type a number that is not on the gym's list
user_sees: 'The gym doesn't have your mobile number yet. Ask the desk to add ... then scan again.'
must_not: A visit written

steps.action: Type a fourth different number the same day
user_sees: 'Too many numbers were tried today. Check in at the desk, and ask them to check your mobile number.'
must_not: A fourth number checked against the list

start: Member joined gym A in the app, scans the poster of an unrelated gym B

steps.action: Scan gym B's poster and tap Check in
user_sees: 'You're not a member of gym B in the app.'
must_not: A visit written in gym A or gym B
Gym B's member names shown

steps.action: Tap Check in 11 times within a minute
user_sees: 'Too many tries in a minute. Wait a minute, then scan again.'
must_not: The 11th try reaching the gym's list

start: Member already checked in today at the desk

steps.action: Scan the poster and tap Check in
user_sees: 'You're checked in at' the time the desk recorded
must_not: A second visit row for today

steps.action: The desk takes the visit back (Undo) in the register; the member scans again
user_sees: 'You're checked in' with the new time; the register shows the visit again with the 'App' tag
must_not: The taken-back visit still hidden after the new scan

steps.action: The member's plan ends; scan the next day
user_sees: A check-in that says the plan has ended and to see the desk
must_not: A plain 'You're checked in' with no word that the plan ended
No visit recorded

start: Someone types another person's mobile number at check-in

steps.action: Type a number that belongs to another member on the gym's list
user_sees: The desk-check message only, with no name and no plan
must_not: The other member's first name, plan, trainer or measurements shown
The phone linked to that member without the desk

steps.action: The desk sees the waiting request and declines it
user_sees: The next scan asks for a number again
must_not: The request approved by itself

steps.action: Type a number that is not on the list
user_sees: 'The gym doesn't have your mobile number yet...' with the typed number
must_not: More than 3 different numbers tried a day by one member
